mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, we have clear skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 55 degrees. Under the Third Quarter moon, we can expect an overnight low of 46 degrees with no rain predicted.

October is now Community Planning Month in Verona, recognizing the Planning and Development Department for their hard work. Also, please keep an eye out for any mail regarding Cross Connection Control surveys to help ensure our water supply remains safe.
We have a busy couple of days ahead with live music today at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmers' Market tomorrow and the World Dairy Expo this Saturday.
On September 21, officers investigated a retail theft at a local business where a suspect was identified stealing candy and subsequently cited.
You can still stop by Culver's tonight for some Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough before they close at 10:30 PM.
